_note: 12 carte Campaign del Red Dust (§1.5), lette dalle immagini del modulo Vassal. Restano in gioco fino alla fase di Reset del Dust Storm Round successivo (§4.3).

cards.title: Construction Workers Guild
cards.subtitle: Workers down tools on CORP projects, help build barricades instead
cards.text: Place all new RD Bases on their Dug-In side.

cards.title: Prison Labor Revolt
cards.subtitle: Penal labor forces strike back
cards.text: Reduce Profits by 1 whenever a CORP Base is placed.

cards.title: Dock Workers Lockout
cards.subtitle: Dock workers locked out after demanding better conditions
cards.text: Discard half (rounded up) of all Supply markers that reach Phobos, before they are converted to MG Resources.

cards.title: Transport Workers
cards.subtitle: Maglevs shut down over work conditions
cards.text: Secure may not use Maglev lines.

cards.title: Water Reclamation Workers
cards.subtitle: Water rationing hits government strongholds hard
cards.text: Labyrinths may not be shifted to Active Support.

cards.title: Mothers of Mars
cards.subtitle: Martian mothers protest the loss of innocent lives
cards.text: Each Labyrinth selected for Assault also shifts 1 level towards Active Opposition.

cards.title: Torture Video Leaks
cards.subtitle: Outrage as CORP black site torture video is leaked on internet
cards.text: CORP units do not contribute towards Control in Labyrinths.

cards.title: Earth-Based Endorsements
cards.subtitle: Earthers for Martian rights!
cards.text: Each Supply marker arriving on Phobos instead increases MG Resources by 2 and RD Resources by 1.

cards.title: Legal Injunctions
cards.subtitle: Friendly judge prevents action
cards.text: Each space with Opposition that is selected for MG Secure costs 6 MG Resources.

cards.title: General Strike
cards.subtitle: Workers all over Mars down tools
cards.text: All MG Operations in spaces without Support cost 1 additional MG Resource.

cards.title: Comms Cutoff
cards.subtitle: Communications with Earth cut
cards.text: Logistics cannot select Transit and CORP Pass does not activate the Aldrin Cycler.

cards.title: Red Wave Elections
cards.subtitle: Local elections sweep in Red Dust friendly candidates
cards.text: When any space shifts from Passive Support to Neutral, instead set it to Passive Opposition.
